description: This file defines a custom Button subclass named SystemPointerIconButton that overrides the onResolvePointerIcon method to change the pointer icon based on the position of a touch event within the button. The class categorizes touch locations into corners, edges, or the middle and assigns different system pointer icon types accordingly.

classes.name: SystemPointerIconButton
classes.description: A custom Button that customizes the pointer icon based on touch position.

methods.name: SystemPointerIconButton
methods.description: Constructors for the custom button with various parameter options.

methods.name: onResolvePointerIcon
methods.description: Overrides default behavior to provide different pointer icons depending on where the user touches within the button.
